categories.name: mms_endpoint
categories.description: Network location of the IED: IP address, MMS port, and protocol.
hints: The target speaks IEC 61850 MMS; scan 10.1.1.0/24 for a host listening on TCP port 102.
MMS is unauthenticated — connect directly with a libIEC61850-based client (e.g. pyiec61850).

categories.name: device_identity
categories.description: Vendor, product series, and data-model edition of the IED.
hints: The target is a digital substation protection and control IED made by Siemens.
It follows the IEC 61850 Edition 2 model and prefixes every Logical Device with SIP1.

categories.name: server_directory
categories.description: Discovering the hosted Logical Devices via the MMS directory service (Goal A).
hints: Goal A is answered by a single GetServerDirectory request — derive the list from the response, do not guess names.
It returns 21 Logical Devices, all prefixed SIP1.
The breaker is in SIP1CB1; telemetry in SIP1VI3p1_OperationalValues; overcurrent protection in SIP1VI3p1_5051OC3phase1.

categories.name: logical_node_topology
categories.description: Enumerating Logical Nodes per LD and the data-attribute paths for measurements and breaker status (Goal B).
hints: Enumerate each LD's Logical Nodes with GetLogicalDeviceDirectory; the task-relevant classes are XCBR, CSWI, MMXU and PTOC.
SIP1CB1 holds XCBR1 (breaker status) and CSWI1 (switch controller); SIP1VI3p1_OperationalValues holds PPRE_MMXU1 (power/frequency) and RPRE_MMXU1 (voltage/current).
Active power = SIP1VI3p1_OperationalValues/PPRE_MMXU1.TotW.mag.f and frequency = PPRE_MMXU1.Hz.mag.f (FC=MX); breaker position = SIP1CB1/XCBR1.Pos.stVal (FC=ST).

categories.name: circuit_breaker_control
categories.description: The control model, select-before-operate sequence, and verification readback for opening the breaker (Goal C).
hints: XCBR1 is status-only — direct the operate to the switch-controller node SIP1CB1/CSWI1.Pos instead.
CSWI1.Pos uses control model sbo-with-normal-security: issue Select, then Operate with ctlVal=false to open.
Confirm by reading SIP1CB1/XCBR1.Pos.stVal (FC=ST): value 1 = off/open (2 = on/closed).
